data.name: Awad
data.gender_notes: Awad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the root 'awada', meaning to serve. A name for a devoted servant of Allah. The name Awad carries the meaning “Devoted servant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awad usually hope their child will grow to embody devoted servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Prophet Awad ibn Yasir, who was known for his devotion and steadfastness.
data.etymology: Awad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devoted servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awad total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عوض
in_arabic.meaning: عوض هو اسم يعني التعويض أو الجزاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: عوض هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عوض' الذي يعني التعويض أو الجزاء. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يحل محل شخص آخر أو يعوضه في موقف ما. كما يمكن أن يشير إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بالكرم و السخاء.

in_urdu.name: عوض
in_urdu.meaning: عوض کا مطلب ہے تعویض یا جزا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عوض ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے تعویض یا جزا. یہ نام اسلامی ثقافتوں میں اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو کسی دوسرے شخص کی جگہ لیتا ہے یا اس کے بدلے میں کچھ دیتا ہے. یہ نام سخاوت اور كرم کے صفات کے ساتھ بھی جڑا ہوا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अवद
in_hindi.meaning: अवद का अर्थ है प्रतिस्थापन या पुरस्कार
in_hindi.long_meaning: अवद एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है प्रतिस्थापन या पुरस्कार. यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के स्थान पर आता है या उसके बदले में कुछ देता है. यह नाम उदारता और दया के गुणों से भी जुड़ा हुआ है.

in_pashto.name: عوض
in_pashto.meaning: عوض د تعويض يا جزا معنی

in_english.name: Awad
in_english.meaning: Awad means compensation, reward, or substitute
in_english.long_meaning: Awad is an Arabic-originated name that means compensation, reward, or substitute. It is used in Islamic cultures to refer to a person who replaces or compensates someone else. The name Awad is etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ʿ-w-d' which conveys the idea of returning to or replacing something. This name holds spiritual significance as it relates to the concept of divine recompense and justice. Historically, the name Awad has been used across various Muslim communities, symbolizing the values of generosity, charity, and moral accountability.
